intro.zh: 这是一本「看图解密」式绘本：画面里藏着前后呼应的细节。右侧「侦探笔记」会随页码更新提示；遇到谜面时，试着把你在画里读到的答案打出来。
intro.en: This picture book is built like a visual puzzle: details echo across spreads. The detective notes update as you read—when a riddle appears, type what you see in the artwork.

pageNotes.zh: 先建立「视觉档案」：记住主角的袜子纹样、配色与场景里反复出现的道具。后面很多页会用「谁在场 / 谁缺席」来误导你。
pageNotes.en: Build a visual inventory: sock patterns, palette, and recurring props. Later spreads play with who is present vs missing.

pageNotes.zh: 把每一跨页当成「现场照片」：注意地面痕迹、光影方向、以及被画得很小但画了两次的东西——重复往往是作者埋的线索。
pageNotes.en: Treat each spread like a crime-scene photo: ground marks, light direction, and tiny objects drawn twice—repetition is often intentional.

pageNotes.zh: 接近谜底时，回到最开始的跨页对照：真正的答案通常早就画在封面或扉页里，只是换了一种距离让你看见。
pageNotes.en: Near the end, compare back to the opening spreads—the answer is often already on the cover or title page, just seen from a new distance.

riddles.promptZh: 侦探社名字里，被「侦」和「探」夹在中间的两个字是什么？（提示：穿在脚上）
riddles.promptEn: In the agency name, what everyday clothing sits between detective work? (Two characters in Chinese.)
riddles.hintZh: 书名四个字里，中间两个就是答案。
riddles.hintEn: Look at the four-character Chinese title on the cover.

riddles.promptZh: 故事里谁在「组织线索」——是侦探本人，还是他收集的证物？用两个字回答：侦探 / 证物
riddles.promptEn: Type 侦探 or 证物 (two characters) depending on who organizes the clues in your reading.
riddles.hintZh: 两种答案都算对，选你画面里更像主角的一方。
riddles.hintEn: Either answer is accepted—pick what feels like the protagonist of your reading.
